description: This file implements a mock version of the AnalyticsBackend interface for testing purposes. It includes methods for configuration, event sending, and interaction with local storage and network via libcurl. It also defines a class AnalyticsBackendMock within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace.

classes.name: AnalyticsBackendMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the IAnalyticsBackend interface used for testing analytics event handling, local storage interaction, and network communication.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the backend with system time and local store, setting up the store with a specific table and limit.

methods.name: SendEvent
methods.description: Prepares a JSON representation of an event, stores it locally, and attempts to send it over HTTP using libcurl.
